apparent_vuln: Share price manipulation via direct token donation
why_false_positive: EIP-4626 compliant vaults using virtual shares (e.g., OpenZeppelin v5 ERC4626) are immune to donation attacks. The virtual offset (1e3 or similar) makes donation economically infeasible. Only flag if virtual shares are NOT present.

When Checks-Effects-Interactions is strictly followed (state updated BEFORE external call), reentrancy is not possible even without ReentrancyGuard. Only flag if state update occurs AFTER the external call.

Sandwich risk is a known user-level risk in AMMs, not a protocol vulnerability, unless the protocol has a specific obligation to protect against it (e.g., aggregator with stated MEV protection). Standard AMMs (Uniswap v2/v3 style) expose this by design.

If voting snapshot is taken at proposal creation time (not execution time), flash loans cannot affect the vote outcome. Only flag if voting power is calculated at execution time or uses spot balances.

Deployment + initialization in one transaction (using constructor or CREATE2 with deterministic salt + immediate init) is front-run safe. Only flag if there is a window between deployment and initialization where a different caller could call initialize().
